checks.manifest: Every declared leaf SHA/size under95MB, relative path/no-symlink guards. C publication verifier separately checks manifest pin/count/complete closure.
checks.source_map: Identity SHA/size checked against package declarations. Repeated aliases must have identical bytes. Old absolute paths are dictionary identities, never given to filesystem operations.
checks.translation: Exactly one old actual QA entry identity is selected. All raw() calls from the SHA-pinned frozen C checker are replaced with mandatory aliases->declared package leaf reads, no fallback. Checked() still verifies all original bindings.
checks.math: __file__ retains logical original identity so input/pair path equality is unchanged; only raw() I/O translation and H fresh result directory are replaced. region()/answer()/22NPZ and all352 checks are untouched. No producer import, inference, thresholds or model/data choice.
checks.output: Fresh --out or OS temporary directory outside immutable package. frozen checker emits a review, wrapper verifies completed/PASS and reports translation count plus fallbackfalse. Root execution pending; no result is claimed here.

limits: Manual full CODE review and compile only, no actual package replay. This checks conditional Boolean arithmetic, not certificate construction, image registration or physical/native gold.
